brief:
Israeli occupation forces set fire to multiple displacement tents Thursday when a quadcopter drone dropped an incendiary bomb near the Khaled al-Hassan school east of Khan Younis in southern Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources confirmed that fires broke out across several tents in the area.

The incident marks another instance of fires sparked in civilian displacement camps, where thousands of Palestinians have sought shelter amid the ongoing conflict.

title: Israeli drone ignites fires in displaced persons' camp east of Khan Younis
